import math

from geometry_msgs.msg import TransformStamped
from tf2_ros.transform_broadcaster import TransformBroadcaster


def ensure_tf_broadcaster(state, node):
    if "tf_broadcaster" not in state:
        state["tf_broadcaster"] = TransformBroadcaster(node)
    return state["tf_broadcaster"]


def _field(value, name, default=None):
    attr = getattr(value, name, default)
    if callable(attr):
        try:
            return attr()
        except TypeError:
            return attr
    return attr


def _set_field(value, name, item):
    attr = getattr(value, name, None)
    if callable(attr):
        try:
            attr(item)
            return
        except TypeError:
            pass
    setattr(value, name, item)


def make_transform(parent, child, translation, rotation):
    transform = TransformStamped()
    header = _field(transform, "header")
    stamp = _field(header, "stamp")
    _set_field(stamp, "sec", 0)
    _set_field(stamp, "nanosec", 0)
    _set_field(header, "frame_id", str(parent))
    _set_field(transform, "child_frame_id", str(child))
    body = _field(transform, "transform")
    trans = _field(body, "translation")
    rot = _field(body, "rotation")
    _set_field(trans, "x", float(translation[0]))
    _set_field(trans, "y", float(translation[1]))
    _set_field(trans, "z", float(translation[2]))
    _set_field(rot, "x", float(rotation[0]))
    _set_field(rot, "y", float(rotation[1]))
    _set_field(rot, "z", float(rotation[2]))
    _set_field(rot, "w", float(rotation[3]))
    return transform
